answer: An honest agent pays this once and forgets it; a farm pays a renewal audit every year per name, at about £50 each on every name, and the tundra is the gap between those two bills. One name, one proof: Enrolled physiotherapist warrant with physiotherapists society verification enforces it through a warrant therapists confirm after session audits, and the plume is the price of faking the second name rather than the first. The spiral is that a hundred proofs cannot share one audit, one interview, or one waiting room.
